race.comment: SPOOKY ART (5) put the writing on the wall when he raced parked but stuck for second two back at Newcastle then maintained the recent momentum last time out when he came from the back row and scored by 2 metres over 1609m at this venue. Steps up in grade but is back on the front row and is going well. JUS BLING IT (6) disappointed as favourite at his latest appearance here but the form prior to that was solid, including a sound third at Newcastle two starts ago. Worth another chance. WICKED LEGEND (8) has finished top-four in his last four outings here, three of those coming from this row. Must be included. COOGEE (4) returns to the front row and has claims off a win here last month.
